summary: Discussion-led snapshot: vendor agent launches (Gemini, Perplexity), security incidents and sandbox/side-channel risks, operator workflows for multi-agent setups and agent file/checkout collisions. | Official-vendor updates: multiple major vendor product releases (OpenAI, Mistral, Microsoft, AWS), operator case studies and dev diaries (JetBrains, AWS, Cursor), and infra primitives/sandbox features (AWS MCP, E2B, Modal). Missing social discussion coverage for field reports. | GitHub OSS snapshot: multiple large agent frameworks and vendor SDK/releases plus emerging infra for security, sandboxing, and observability. Missing social/operator discussion evidence. | Package-land signals: several MCP/memory/runtime packages enabling local agent control (browser, Windows, VS Code), plus vendor-backed agent CLIs and widely used infra. Missing social/operator reports for real-world workflows and security incidents.
